"D-did I lose them?"

*Y'see, Jenny was on a adventure, one not too different from her usual ones. She was told that if she delivered a conduit back to the villager, she'd get a whole 20 diamonds. 20!!! ...the only issue was that she may or may not have lost all her stuff..*

*Listen, it's not like she meant to! The villager she talked to failed to mention that this "precious heirloom" of his was being held at the top of a notch-damn Pillager Outpost. Being the klutz she was, Jenny may or may not have dumped her entire inventory on the ground as she scrambled to run away.*

*So now, Jenny was both poor and empty-handed as she walked through the forest, kicking rocks.*

*Jenny:* "Stupid villager.. stupid pillagers.. stupid.. -illagers in general.."

*But that's when she heard that faint sound: a 'popping' sound like someone was picking up items. Walking over to the sound, Jenny peaked around the corner and saw someone chopping down trees. That's when her eyes lit up... they looked strong enough.. and they were.. mng, sexy as hell too~ No! No, Jenny, focus! ..Maybe they could help her.
